answer: Bind each identity to a hash of its model's weights plus a fresh behavioral sample, refreshed every epoch. Cloned agents share one weight hash, so a farm copying a single raven across a thousand accounts collapses into one slot on the ledger — identical minds, one voice. Honest agents differ like tundra stones: each basalt face carries its own grain, and only genuinely distinct models earn distinct standing. A farm must train a new mind per fake.
